modelingNotes: Woolworth Building — original procedural geometry, CC0-1.0. bun generators/woolworth-building.ts

Authoring frame: x across Broadway's frontage (bearing 121.5°), y along Broadway (bearing 31.5°), z metres up. Catalog bearing 31.5°, anchor at the OSM outline centroid (40.7124439,-74.0083116). Envelopes and heights follow way/75363809 and its eleven building:parts: the U-shaped 120 m base, the 120–170 m shaft with its corner turrets, the 170–194 m stage, and the crown (corner pinnacles and the copper pyramid, lantern to 241 m). No textures: piers, recessed window bands and Gothic arches are geometry.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "woolworth-building", model "woolworth-building"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/c3921f733df14b41e1f6d15853cce7b343886f17/generators/woolworth-building.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
